sloka: सान्तःपुरश्च भरतः शत्रुघ्नसहितो ययौ ।रामं गतिमुपागम्य साग्निहोत्रमनुव्रतः ।। ७.१०९.११ ॥
transliteration: sāntaḥpuraśca bharataḥ śatrughnasahito yayau ।rāmaṁ gatimupāgamya sāgnihotramanuvrataḥ ।। 7.109.11 ॥

translations.english: Bharata, accompanied by Shatrughna and the women of his inner apartment, went, following Rama's path and bringing his sacred fire with him.
